title: WATCH run summary is secret-scrubbed before the thread comment and spawn log
description: WATCH run summary is secret-scrubbed before the thread comment and spawn log
acceptance_criteria: a WATCH run whose agent summary, stderr fallback or spawn error contains a vendor token (e.g. ghp_) posts a summary comment on the GitHub thread and appends a spawn-log JSONL line that hold [redacted:<kind>] and never the raw token or a clipped token prefix; token-free summaries are posted and logged unchanged
